name: GLEN Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, Glen Industries Limited (GIL) is engaged in the manufacturing of eco-friendly food packaging and service products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Glen Industries Limited, originally incorporated as Glen Stationery Private Limited in 2007, is engaged in the manufacturing of food packaging and service products, including Thin-Wall Food Containers, Polylactic Acid (PLA) Straws, and Paper Straws.
The company caters to HoReCa, QSR, food & beverage, and dairy industries. Its operations span product design, development, manufacturing, and distribution, adhering to international hygiene and quality standards.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.7%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
